title: 2-D Histogram
text: Generate histogram from input, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Trigger type} sets Reset condition of running histogram; {Lower limit of histogram} sets the lower limit of lowest-valued bin, {Upper limit of histogram} sets the upper limit of highest-valued bin, {Number of bins}, {Find the histogram over} sets the dimension along which to compute histogram Entire, {Normalized} sets the normalize histogram output, {Running histogram} sets the frequency distribution for successive and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Lower limit of histogram
params.values: Lower limit of lowest-valued bin 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Upper limit of histogram
params.values: Upper limit of highest-valued bin 1 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Number of bins
params.values: Number of bins in histogram 256 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Find the histogram over
params.values: Dimension along which to compute histogram Entire input (default) | Each column

params.name: Running histogram
params.values: Frequency distribution for successive inputs off (default) | on

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Reset condition of running histogram None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
